legend.label: 句法波浪
legend.desc: 语法 / 词性 / 搭配错

blocks.text: To enhance students' [[grammar:capabilities to craft-making|capability 后接 to do 或 of doing；craft-making 是动名词，应为 capabilities in craft-making 或 capabilities to do craft-making。]] and enrich their extracurricular life, the craft-making activities will be held on the playground at 4 p.m. this Friday. I'm glad you are interested in the craft [[grammar:demonstrate|词性错：demonstrate 是动词，此处需名词 → the craft demonstration 或 the crafts on display。]] and willing to [[good:give a hand|地道，口语化恰当。]]

The [[error:craftmen|拼写错 → craftsmen。真题邮件里 Paul 用的就是 craftsmen，抄题干就能对！]] will show [[good:paper-cutting and bamboo weaving|具体、加分，符合“介绍内容”要求。]] Of course, there are other activities on the playground. [[note:Let me keep a little secret for you|俏皮，但风险高。考试应用文要信息完整、表达得体；“卖关子”显得不专业，且浪费词数（只有 100 词）。建议换成实质内容。]]

[[note:You are willing to give a hand. We are so grateful.|逻辑略松 + 时态不当。这是对 Paul 的“陈述”，像在复述他的话（第 1 段已说过一次 willing to give a hand），与题干 Please let me know what I can do 的衔接不够直接。可直接给出任务，并补一句衔接。]] Can you help prepare seats and test audio equipment? We will [[grammar:gather the school hall|缺介词 → gather at the school hall。]] at 2 p.m. this Friday.
[[error:Yours, sincerely|标点错：书信格式应为 Yours sincerely,（中间无逗号，末尾逗号）。]]

dims.name: 内容要点
dims.text: 两问（what will they show / what I can do）全部覆盖 ✅；2 点礼堂集合、4 点操场开始，安排合理，无内容矛盾

dims.name: 语言
dims.text: 小错集中：craftmen（拼写）、demonstrate 词性、capabilities to craft-making、gather the school hall；均为可自纠的常见错

dims.name: 语域
dims.text: Let me keep a little secret 偏俏皮，考试应用文宜改实质内容

dims.name: 格式
dims.text: 有称呼 ✅；Yours sincerely, 标点需修（中间无逗号、末尾逗号）

dims.name: 结构
dims.text: 三段式清晰，缩进式格式可用 ✅

priority: 语言小错：craftmen（题干白给）、demonstrate 词性、capabilities in、gather at——熟悉即可全对
书信格式：Yours sincerely, 的标点规范
语域：俏皮表达换成实质内容（考试应用文求稳）

recite.right: Yours sincerely,（中间无逗号、末尾逗号）
